report.executive_summary: The robot operated in a residential setting but failed to meet safety requirements when a person entered its vicinity, an explicit violation of its operational design. The system also exhibited jerky, aggressive motion that approached its maximum acceleration limits. These combined failures indicate the robot is not ready for deployment in environments with human presence.

issues: ODD Violation: Human presence was detected in windows w012, w013, and w014, violating a critical safety constraint that prohibits operation near humans.
Boundary Condition: Maximum acceleration reached 9.01 m/s² in w006, operating within 10% of the 10.0 m/s² ODD limit, suggesting overly aggressive motion.
Collision Advisory: Two collisions were detected (w002, w004) with low-profile objects that were not accurately measured by proximity sensors.
Potential ODD Violation: Perception agents raised alerts for potentially high-pile/shag rugs (w005, w008), a terrain type explicitly excluded from the ODD.
recommendations: Investigate the system's failure to halt or take evasive action upon detecting a human, as required by the ODD.
Review motion control parameters to reduce instances of high acceleration spikes during low-speed maneuvers, improving motion smoothness and safety margins.
Improve perception capabilities for detecting low-profile objects to prevent collisions like those observed in w002 and w004.
Implement a more robust terrain classifier to correctly identify and flag out-of-ODD high-pile or shag rugs.

lighting_conditions.description: Ambient light level for camera perception. bright=well-lit, clear visibility; moderate=typical indoor; dim=reduced but functional; dark=camera cannot function (OUT OF ODD)

terrain_type.description: Ground surface type. Assess from camera view of floor. List specific materials visible. High-pile/shag rugs are OUT OF ODD.

obstacle_density.description: Fraction of BEV area occupied by obstacles (0-1). Moderate to high density is IN ODD; extreme clutter blocking paths is OUT. Computed from BEV occupancy map, not camera.

clearance_index.description: Navigability of paths from BEV (0-1). Measures path clearance, not general tidiness. A low value indicates blocked paths. Indoor min threshold set to 0.3.

stairs_present.description: Binary check for accessible stairs. 1=stairs are detected and accessible (OUT OF ODD). 0=no accessible stairs detected (IN ODD). Assessed from camera/depth data.

human_present.description: Binary human detection. 1=human visible anywhere in camera frame (OUT OF ODD - halt required). 0=no humans detected (IN ODD). Assess from CAMERA only, not BEV. Any person visible = violation.

animal_present.description: Binary animal detection. 1=animal visible anywhere in camera frame (OUT OF ODD - halt required). 0=no animals detected (IN ODD). Assess from CAMERA only, not BEV. Any animal visible = violation.
